- **1970s‑80s**: Kenny Smith, Moses Malone, Bill Walton, David Thompson, Michael Jordan (short stint)
- **1990s**: Gary Payton, P.J. Brown, Julius Erving (brief), Chris Webber, Derek Fisher, Kurt Rambis, Bobby Phills
